visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female doctor with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a white satin shirt, speaks directly to the camera in a professional office. The background includes framed certificates, a wood-slat wall, a black lamp, and a designer bag. Large yellow and blue captions appear at the bottom. (2) A close-up shot shows a medical device with a glowing green ring being applied to a patient's neck in a clinical setting. The patient's skin is being treated with a clear gel. (3) The doctor is back on screen, gesturing with both hands while explaining. Small pink heart graphics and sparkle effects appear around her head. (4) A split-screen graphic displays Before and After profile shots of a woman's jawline, highlighting skin texture and lifting. Text labels in Chinese are visible below the images. (5) The doctor concludes her explanation, gesturing frequently with her right hand. An OK hand icon and cartoon eyes overlay briefly on the screen. (6) The final scene is a static gray and white graphic showing the clinic's logo, contact information, and address details.
